about: Post-door (from Start E4R1 on) and slow-event evidence from the runner's 2026-11 streams, read from the committed transcripts / starter tables and the raw .srt/.txt transcripts under ignored/downloaded (read only; no new transcription). External claims by the runner about his own runs; times +-0.5 min. Used by tools/fit_post_evidence.py. 'fights' = the model's post-door fights in order; each door attempt lists where it ended. Quality: A solid (timer + statement), B statement with some inference, C anecdote (remembered, selection towards notable runs).
